name: TA'AKTANA, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Labuan Bajo
positioning: Luxury Collection resort on the Flores Sea in Labuan Bajo, with villas on land and over the water and boat trips into Komodo National Park
best_for: Couples wanting an overwater villa with ocean views
Divers and island-hoppers exploring Komodo National Park
Families wanting a Kids Club and a beachside pool for all ages

facts.text: The resort is on Pantai Wae Rana in Labuan Bajo, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia.
The resort spans 16 hectares between lush forests and the shores of the Flores Sea.
The resort's design is inspired by the Lingko fields and their spider web-shaped rice terraces.
One-Bedroom Villas have a private terrace and pool.
Every villa comes with 24/7 butler service.
Guests find a handcrafted traditional lantern in their suite or villa, a symbol of the Manggarai people.
The wellness center has hot and cold plunge pools and six treatment rooms inspired by nearby caves.
The resort has an Olympic-sized swimming pool, a Kids Club and an overwater bar.
A sprawling beachside pool for all ages has a swim-up bar.
Kids Club activities include Bajo canvas painting, Manggarian storytelling and Rangku Alu dance.
Private yacht trips come with a dedicated butler, a personalized itinerary and a gourmet beachside picnic.
At Nera Lounge, the Sunset Ritual is a complimentary cocktail infused with local botanicals.

highlights.text: Overwater Sea Villas float above the water and feature macrame artwork of neighboring islands and marine life, phinisi boat relics and a carpet inspired by Pink Beach.
Island-hopping trips sail into Komodo National Park, where guests can see Komodo dragons in their natural habitat.
Dives depart from the resort's private jetty to sites developed by its Marine Specialist Team.
Di'a Spa is inspired by the sacred caves of Rangko and Batu Cermin.
The three-bedroom Mansion has two living spaces, indoor and outdoor dining areas, a private infinity pool and a terrace.

considerations.text: Komodo Airport (LBJ) is about 2.5 km from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 17.
WhataHotel notes the remote Indonesian location requires multiple flight connections.
